1001.name: wo-chien

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king’s evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.
It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.

1001.description: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king’s evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.
1001.flavorText: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king’s evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.

1002.name: chien-pao

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.
The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.

1002.description: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.
1002.flavorText: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.

1003.name: ting-lu

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.
It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

1003.description: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.
1003.flavorText: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.

1004.name: chi-yu

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.
The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.

1004.description: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.
1004.flavorText: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

1005.name: roaring-moon

genera.genus: パラドックスポケモン

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.
According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.

1005.description: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.
1005.flavorText: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.

1006.name: iron-valiant

genera.genus: パラドックスポケモン

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: It has some similarities to a mad scientist’s invention covered in a paranormal magazine.
It’s possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.

1006.description: It has some similarities to a mad scientist’s invention covered in a paranormal magazine.
1006.flavorText: It has some similarities to a mad scientist’s invention covered in a paranormal magazine.

1007.name: koraidon

genera.genus: パラドックスポケモン

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.
This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.

1007.description: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.
1007.flavorText: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

1008.name: miraidon

genera.genus: パラドックスポケモン

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.
This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

1008.description: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.
1008.flavorText: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

1009.name: walking-wake

genera.genus: パラドックスポケモン

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old expedition journal.
It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune.

1009.description: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old expedition journal.
1009.flavorText: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old expedition journal.

1010.name: iron-leaves

genera.genus: パラドックスポケモン

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: Many of its physical characteristics match those of a Virizion from the future that was covered in a paranormal magazine.
According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

1010.description: Many of its physical characteristics match those of a Virizion from the future that was covered in a paranormal magazine.
1010.flavorText: Many of its physical characteristics match those of a Virizion from the future that was covered in a paranormal magazine.

1011.name: dipplin

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.
The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

1011.description: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.
1011.flavorText: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.

1012.name: poltchageist

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.
Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

1012.description: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.
1012.flavorText: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.

1013.name: sinistcha

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.
It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

1013.description: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.
1013.flavorText: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.

1014.name: okidogi

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and gained a powerful physique.
Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

1014.description: After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and gained a powerful physique.
1014.flavorText: After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and gained a powerful physique.

1015.name: munkidori

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities. It stimulated Munkidori's brain and caused the Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom.
Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

1015.description: The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities. It stimulated Munkidori's brain and caused the Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom.
1015.flavorText: The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities. It stimulated Munkidori's brain and caused the Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom.

1016.name: fezandipiti

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the chain wrapped around its body.
Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.

1016.description: Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the chain wrapped around its body.
1016.flavorText: Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the chain wrapped around its body.

1017.name: ogerpon

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.
This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

1017.description: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.
1017.flavorText: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

1018.name: archaludon

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.
It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.

1018.description: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.
1018.flavorText: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.

1019.name: hydrapple

genera.genus: りんごオロチポケモン
りんごオロチポケモン

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.
These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.

1019.description: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.
1019.flavorText: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.

1020.name: gouging-fire

genera.genus: パラドックスポケモン
パラドックスポケモン

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.
It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.

1020.description: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.
1020.flavorText: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.

1021.name: raging-bolt

genera.genus: パラドックスポケモン
パラドックスポケモン

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.
It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.

1021.description: It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.
1021.flavorText: It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.

1022.name: iron-boulder

genera.genus: パラドックスポケモン
パラドックスポケモン

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: It resembles a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a Terrakion that had been modified by an evil organization.
It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

1022.description: It resembles a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a Terrakion that had been modified by an evil organization.
1022.flavorText: It resembles a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a Terrakion that had been modified by an evil organization.

1023.name: iron-crown

genera.genus: パラドックスポケモン
パラドックスポケモン

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: It resembles a mysterious object introduced in a paranormal magazine as a cutting-edge weapon shaped like a Cobalion.
There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.

1023.description: It resembles a mysterious object introduced in a paranormal magazine as a cutting-edge weapon shaped like a Cobalion.
1023.flavorText: It resembles a mysterious object introduced in a paranormal magazine as a cutting-edge weapon shaped like a Cobalion.

1024.name: terapagos

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon is the source of the Terastal phenomenon.
It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.

1024.description: Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon is the source of the Terastal phenomenon.
1024.flavorText: Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon is the source of the Terastal phenomenon.

1025.name: pecharunt

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires and capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall under Pecharunt’s control, chained to its will.
Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.

1025.description: It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires and capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall under Pecharunt’s control, chained to its will.
1025.flavorText: It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires and capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall under Pecharunt’s control, chained to its will.
